selection.method: sort ascending by sha256(source_id + NUL + revision + NUL + parent_id)

amendments.trigger: Step 3 v1 at max_length=256 accepted 0/2000 math candidates and only 2780/8000 candidates overall
amendments.scope: Day 09 Step 3 onward; tokenizer revision, chat template, right truncation, assistant-only loss mask, padding, and packing policies remain unchanged

amendments.trigger: Step 3 v2 at max_length=1024 rejected 1619/2000 math candidates while the other slices accepted at least 97.15%
amendments.scope: Day 09 Step 3 onward; tokenizer revision, chat template, right truncation, assistant-only loss mask, padding, and packing policies remain unchanged

preprocessing.loss_mask: all assistant bodies plus each assistant <|im_end|>

identity.content_hash: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON messages with sorted object keys and compact separators

token_count_definitions.raw_token_count: sum of each raw message content tokenized separately with the frozen tokenizer and add_special_tokens=false; no role headers or chat template
token_count_definitions.rendered_token_count: full chat-template token count before truncation
token_count_definitions.input_token_count: model input token count after right truncation and before padding
token_count_definitions.supervised_token_count: post-truncation labels whose value is not -100

quality_audit.cohort: Step 3 accepted records before quality filtering, exact dedup, near-duplicate decisions, and decontamination

difficulty_proxy.name: supervised_response_length_v1
difficulty_proxy.caveat: Response length is a workload proxy, not a correctness or semantic-difficulty label.

refusal_heuristic.name: assistant_phrase_match_v1
refusal_heuristic.caveat: This is a deterministic risk hint and may contain false positives or miss paraphrased refusals.

template_cluster.name: normalized_prompt_prefix_v1
template_cluster.caveat: Prefix clusters are candidate-generation hints, not duplicate or quality-removal decisions.

exact_dedup.complete_record_serialization: canonical JSON array of [role, normalized content] pairs
survivor_rule: slice priority: finance, general, math, code
exact_dedup.prompt_answer_only_policy: risk evidence only; no automatic deletion

near_duplicate.pair_scope: all unordered pairs within and across training sources
near_duplicate.policy: candidate generation only; no automatic deletion

near_review_calibration.selection_method: within each ordered stratum, sort unique pairs by sha256(version + NUL + stratum name + NUL + candidate_id); exclude pairs already selected by an earlier stratum

gate_b_decision.confirmation: User reviewed the stratified package and concluded the pairs should be kept because they are parameterized or paraphrased task variants.
gate_b_decision.remaining_candidate_policy: Candidate status alone is non-terminal. Retain unreviewed within-source non-exact-complete-record pairs unless a future confirmed decision identifies a removal.

eval_candidates.selection_method: sort ascending by sha256(version + NUL + source + NUL + revision + NUL + split + NUL + parent_id), then parent_id
eval_candidates.candidate_policy: content and IDs fixed on Day 09; decoder, scorer, baselines, and final protocol remain unfrozen until Day 10

decontamination.train_cohort: Step 6 exact-deduped pool before any Gate B contamination decisions
decontamination.policy: candidate generation only; no automatic train or eval deletion

gate_b_decision.result: No train/eval candidates required a human removal decision under the frozen Step 9 matcher configuration.

clean_pool.clean_pool_hash_definition: sha256 of canonical JSON array of records sorted by sample_id
clean_pool.manifest_hash_definition: sha256 of canonical JSON object containing header without manifest_hash and records sorted by sample_id
clean_pool.policy: Apply only confirmed removals; similarity candidates without a confirmed removal remain in the clean parent pool.

token_budget.objective: maximum common total exactly achievable by both mixtures with whole examples and no replacement; allow replacement only if no positive exact solution exists
token_budget.stable_candidate_order: sha256(version + NUL + mix + NUL + slice + NUL + sample_id), then sample_id
token_budget.subset_solver: integer bitset reachability with deterministic reverse reconstruction

mixture_materialization.occurrence_order: sort ascending by sha256(str(occurrence_order_seed) + NUL + mix_name + NUL + canonical_sample_id + NUL + occurrence_index), then occurrence_id
mixture_materialization.canonical_identity_policy: preserve sample_id as canonical_sample_id and store occurrence_id separately

selection_method: include the lowest stable hash refusal-hint sample when available
include the lowest stable hash repeated-prefix-cluster sample when available
fill remaining slots by sha256(gate_a_version + NUL + sample_id)

gate_a_decision.confirmation: User manually reviewed the Gate A package and confirmed the quality is acceptable.

gate_c.decision_basis: User explicitly requested that Gate C be skipped and Day 09 be completed.
gate_c.claim_boundary: Gate C was waived, not passed; no final occurrence-level human quality evidence was collected.

ordered_filters.name: confirmed_manual_quality_v1
ordered_filters.scope: Gate A and any approved expanded review decisions

ordered_filters.name: deterministic_guardrails_v1
ordered_filters.action: exclude records with a proven invariant violation

quality_filter.filter_decision_order: contract -> confirmed manual quality -> deterministic guardrails
quality_filter.downstream_eligibility_requires: Gate A complete or a documented expanded-review conclusion
